name: nest_home_control
description: Read and control the Nest thermostat.

inputs.name: action
inputs.description:
Choose ONE based on user intent:
- ``set_target_temperature`` — when the user asks to CHANGE THE TEMPERATURE (e.g. 'set to 70', 'make it cooler', '70F'). Requires ``target_temperature``. This is the most common action.
- ``set_mode`` — when the user asks to CHANGE THE MODE (heating vs cooling vs off). Requires ``mode``. Rare.
- ``set_fan_mode`` — when the user asks about the FAN. Requires ``fan_mode``.
- ``set_eco_mode`` — when the user asks to turn eco on/off. Requires ``enabled``.
- ``get_status`` — read current state; no other args.

HEURISTIC: if the user mentions a number of degrees, use ``set_target_temperature``, NOT ``set_mode``.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description:
Required ONLY for action=set_mode. Pass the canonical uppercase value with NO underscore/hyphen/space:
- ``HEAT`` — heating only. User says 'set to heat', 'turn the heat on', 'heat mode'.
- ``COOL`` — cooling only (A/C). User says 'set to cool', 'turn on the A/C', 'cooling mode', 'AC'.
- ``HEATCOOL`` — auto heat-or-cool (year-round auto). User says 'auto', 'auto mode', 'heat and cool'.
- ``OFF`` — thermostat off. User says 'turn it off', 'shut it off'.

Do NOT pass lowercase ('heat', 'cool'), underscored ('heat_cool'), or extra spacing — the bridge normalizes these but the canonical value above is what you should emit.

Do NOT provide this for action=set_target_temperature.

inputs.name: target_temperature
inputs.description: Required for action=set_target_temperature. A single numeric value in Fahrenheit (e.g. 70 for '70F'). Do NOT leave this null when the user asked to change the temperature.

inputs.name: fan_mode
inputs.description:
Required ONLY for action=set_fan_mode. Canonical uppercase values:
- ``ON`` — fan always on.
- ``AUTO`` — fan cycles with system.
- ``OFF`` — fan off.
